evidence: Shared state: test.sh:104-113 starts one app process and DB; test.sh:212-227 runs gates then scored with no reseed/reset, so each later dimension sees prior mutations (gates create a job+card; functional creates J1/J2/J3, moves, rejections, messages, a restart; polish creates a job, sends messages in Noor's conversation). Each Playwright MCP is launched --isolated (all judge.toml), so browser-local state does not carry over, but server state does. Wording is state-relative throughout: app_context.md:27-31 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count'; functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review), never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts'; polish prompt.md:14 'Use your own new job and cards ... never rely on another review's records'; visual prompt.md:14 is read-only after its gate and 'a seeded job is fine' (no dimension mutates seeded jobs). Gate setups use unique titles/emails (constraints judge.toml:23), so they cannot collide with functional's A/J2 duplicate-email or ordering checks. Criteria grade deltas, not absolutes: hro_unread_counts 'rises by exactly two and his total by two' (functional judge.toml:335), hro_unread_scrolled_up 'told there is one new message' (:344), hro_thread_latest 'most recent 30' and hro_thread_earlier 'remaining count' without a fixed total (:317,:326), hro_restart compares against the judge's own recorded state (:407, prompt.md:51), hro_activity filters to the review's own job (:263). The only absolute seed dependency is Lena's 1 unread (prompt.md:25, judge.toml:335); seed confirms APP-301 has 3 messages and USR-CAN3 read_count 2 (=1 unread), and no gate, polish or visual step signs in as Lena or messages APP-301, so it survives any dimension order. Noor's 120 seeded messages (APP-101: 120) may grow if polish ran earlier, but the criteria do not hard-code 120 and app_context forbids relying on it. Adversarial: a broken app that resets/reseeds on each start would not be shielded by this design (hro_restart catches reseeding); a conforming app that stores drafts server-side per user (allowed by instruction.md 'when I sign back in it is still there') could carry functional T's deliberately unsent second draft (prompt.md:39 never sends it) into polish hro_pol_live_thread/hro_pol_session_resume, prefilling the box; polish requires 'still reads exactly what was typed', which a careful judge compares before/after, so this is a latent P3 ambiguity, not a demonstrated misgrade. Risk=true because no full configured sequential verifier run exists: raw-evidence-index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent' and rewardkit's actual dimension order within /tests/scored was not observed, so cross-dimension tolerance is source-reviewed only.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening (P3): in functional protocol T, send or clear the second unsent draft before leaving T, or in polish tell the judge to clear any pre-existing draft text in a conversation box and record its value before typing.
